displayIdentity.body: Travel plans and named coworkers close the letter. When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there. All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
